name: Ikhtiyar al-Din Muhammad Bakhtiyar Khalji
contribution: He led the conquest associated with Nadia in 1204-1205, defeating Sena authority in a major political center and opening a new phase of rule in Bengal.
context: Late Sena-era Bengal and early Turkic expansion in eastern India.
impact: His campaign marked a durable rupture in Bengal's political order and shaped the transition toward later sultanate-era state formation.
seoTitle: Bakhtiyar Khalji: Conquest of Nadia and Bengal
seoDescription: Explore Bakhtiyar Khalji's 1204–05 conquest of Nadia and its place in Bengal's transition to sultanate-era rule.
shortAnswer: Bakhtiyar Khalji was a Turkic military commander whose conquest of Nadia opened a new phase in Bengal's political history.
alternateNames: Ikhtiyar al-Din Muhammad bin Bakhtiyar Khalji
